## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written first and seen failing (TDD)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits, in English
- [ ] Generated puzzles are unchanged, **or** the change is intentional and listed in `CHANGELOG.md` under *Puzzle output*
- [ ] No new dependency, **or** it was checked as described in `.claude/skills/adding-dependencies`
- [ ] Wiki page / `docs/architecture.md` updated if needed
